Definition: perfections, i.e. (techn.) one of the epithets of the objects in the high-priest's breastplate as an emblem of complete Truth
BiblicalUsage: Thummim = "perfection"; 1) stones provided for the means of achieving a sacred lot; 1a) used with the Urim, the will of God was revealed
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
